app.name: KhelTara
app.tagline: A short sporting check with the phone you already have.
home.mode.casual.sub: One short check. Share a card with your family.
home.mode.athlete.sub: Pick a sport. Test again. Watch your progress.
home.how: Hold the phone on your chest, or tie it with a dupatta or scarf. No other kit.
home.disclaimer: Screening for referral, not selection. Charts use provisional norms, not validated.
lang.title: Choose your language
lang.fallback: This language pack is not finished. English is shown until a native speaker reviews it.
onboard.title: About you
onboard.name: What should we call you?
onboard.need: Add your name and age to continue.
onboard.sport: Which sport are you hoping for?
onboard.hold.title: How to hold the phone
onboard.hold.body: Hold the phone flat on your chest with both hands. Elbows in. Or tie it there with a dupatta, scarf, or belt. A soft floor is better.
c0.script: We will type your age. If you know your height and weight, type them. For height, stand straight next to a wall. Put a book on your head. Mark the wall. Measure with a school ruler or measuring tape. Or tap Skip.
consent.title: A parent or guardian must agree
consent.body: You are under 18. A parent or guardian agrees before this screening is saved. We do not show ads.
consent.name: Parent or guardian name
consent.check: I am the parent or legal guardian. I agree to save this screening for this child. I understand this is not a selection.
consent.law: This step follows India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act for anyone under 18.
battery.title: Your check
battery.sub: Six tests. The step test takes about three minutes. Rest whenever you need.
battery.sampleAll.sub: This fills the check with sample motion so you can learn the steps. It is not your body and not your score.
test.sample.sub: Sample motion, not your body. A real try uses the phone sensors.
test.buddy.script: Ask a friend or parent to watch. They can tap Ready and Done, hold your feet for sit-ups, and keep you safe.
test.ios: On iPhone, tap Allow when Safari asks to use motion.
test.android: On Android, allow motion if Chrome or Samsung Internet asks. The camera light is only for the heart step.
err.cmj.shake: The phone moved before the jump. Hold it tight on your chest, stand still, then try again.
err.cmj.knees: The phone spun in the air. Hold it flat on your chest and jump straight up.
err.cmj.unclear: We did not see a clear jump. Bend your knees, jump up, and land softly.
err.repeat.lost: We lost count. Keep the phone on your chest and jump in one spot.
err.balance.foot: Your foot came down. Stand tall and try that leg again.
err.situp.small: The sit-up was too small. Come up higher, then lie back.
err.rt.early: That tap was too early. Wait for the green light.
err.step.miss: We did not see enough steps. Step up and down with the beep.
err.ppg.finger: The camera could not see your finger. Cover it softly. Do not press hard.
err.tap.small: Those taps were too few. Tap left and right as fast as you can.
err.sprint.quick: That was too quick. Run the whole way, then tap.
err.shuttle.quick: That was too quick. Touch each line and turn, four times.
err.sensor: This phone is not sharing motion yet. Tap Allow, or open Sensor check.
qc.lowRate: The phone is measuring too slowly. Close other apps, keep this page open, and try again.
cmj.ready: Hold the phone on your chest with both hands. Elbows in. Stand still. Soft floor is better. Bend knees, then jump up as high as you can. Keep holding the phone. Land soft. We will do one practice, then two jumps.
cmj.safety: If your knees or back hurt, skip this test.
repeat.ready: Same hold on the chest. When you hear go, keep jumping until the beep stops. Small quick jumps are OK. One practice of five seconds, then fifteen seconds.
repeat.safety: If your knees or back hurt, skip this test.
balance.ready: Hold phone to chest. Lift one foot. Stand like a tree. Try not to hop. Twenty seconds. Then other foot. Friend may stand near you.
balance.safety: Stand next to a wall. If you feel dizzy, stop.
situp.ready: Lie on your back. Knees bent. Phone on chest. Friend may hold your feet. Sit up until elbow near knee, then down. Do as many as you can in thirty seconds. One slow practice first.
situp.safety: Neck pain? Skip. Do not pull your neck with hands.
rt.ready: Hold the phone in your hand. Wait for the green light or sound. Then tap fast. Do not tap early. Practice three times.
tap.ready: Tap left-right as fast as you can for ten seconds.
step.ready: Find one safe step (stair or doorstep). Phone can sit in pocket or you hold it. Step up and down with the beeps. This stepping part takes about three minutes. Then sit. Put your fingertip gently on the camera light. Stay still.
step.do: Up, down, up, down… Now finger on camera… still…
step.safety: Hold a railing. Stop if chest pain or dizziness.
sprint.ready: Put chappals or stones at start and end of about thirty steps of open ground. Hold phone or pocket. Wait for beep. Run straight past the end mark.
shuttle.ready: Two marks ten steps apart. Run back and forth four times to the voice.
results.title: Your screening card
results.disclaimer: Provisional norms, not validated. Screening for referral, not selection.
results.percentile: About {n} of 100 on the provisional chart
results.empty: Finish at least one test to see a card.
results.maturity: Growth-spurt estimate: {y} years (Mirwald). Not a medical test.
results.sampleNote: This card includes practice samples. Those numbers are not your body.
results.referral: A high clear score can be sent to a coach or centre for a real retest.
results.notSelection: This app does not select or reject anyone.
timeline.title: Your progress
timeline.empty: No checks saved yet. Your next check will show here.
invite.title: Invite friends
invite.sub: Share your link. When someone joins on a phone, they are counted here.
invite.people: People who joined with your code
invite.none: No one has joined with your code yet.
nominate.title: Spot a talent
nominate.sub: This only invites them. It does not create a score until they, or their parent, join and agree.
nominate.name: Their name
nominate.consent: The person, or their parent if they are under 18, has agreed to be contacted.
nominate.parent: A parent or guardian has agreed.
nominate.need: Consent is required. No scored profile is created from this form.
nominate.saved: Saved. They still need to join and agree.
nominate.spotter: Talent Spotter unlocks only after they join and pass a clear check.
family.title: Family
family.sub: A parent can add children. Each child has their own check.
family.consent: I am the parent or guardian and I agree to this child's screening.
profile.title: Profile
profile.centre.help: Centre-verified is for a retest at a club, school, or talent centre. Until then this profile stays self-tested.
profile.centre.name: Centre, school, or club
profile.centre.check: This was a centre retest, not only a home check.
heart.skipped: Heart rate was skipped. The steps still count.
ppg.note: The camera stays in memory only. No video is saved.
err.sensor.none: This browser has no motion sensor. Use Chrome on Android or Safari on iPhone, or see an example result.
err.sensor.denied: Motion was blocked. Tap Allow when the phone asks, then try again.
err.sensor.nograv: This browser hid gravity, so jumps cannot be measured. Open the page in Chrome or Safari.
err.sensor.insecure: Motion needs a secure page. Use the https link, not a copied file.
sensor.title: Sensor check
sensor.lead: Move the phone. The numbers should change. Then you know the tests can see you.
sensor.none: No motion yet. Tap the button and allow sensors.
sensor.denied: Sensors are blocked. Allow motion, then tap again.
sensor.slow: Samples are slow. Close other apps and try again.
sensor.nograv: Gravity is hidden. Try Chrome or Safari.
sensor.insecure: Open the https page so sensors can run.
stuck.label: Stuck?
stuck.title: Need a hand?
steps.cmj.1: Hold the phone flat on your chest. A scarf can hold it.
steps.cmj.3: Jump up as high as you can. Land softly.
steps.repeat.1: Keep the phone on your chest.
steps.repeat.2: Jump up and down in one spot.
steps.repeat.3: Keep going until the beep stops.
steps.balance.1: Hold the phone on your chest.
steps.balance.2: Lift one foot. Stand like a tree.
steps.balance.3: Stay still until the time ends. Then change feet.
steps.situp.1: Lie on your back. Bend your knees.
steps.situp.2: Put the phone on your chest.
steps.situp.3: Sit up and lie back. A friend can hold your feet.
steps.react.1: Hold the phone in one hand.
steps.react.3: Tap when it turns green. Then tap left and right fast.
steps.step.1: Find a low step. Hold the rail.
steps.step.2: Step up and down with the beeps.
steps.step.3: Sit. Put a fingertip on the back camera. Hold still.
steps.sprint.1: Put two marks about thirty long steps apart.
steps.sprint.2: Wait for the beep. Run straight.
steps.sprint.3: Tap the button when you pass the finish.
steps.shuttle.1: Put two marks about ten steps apart.
steps.shuttle.2: Run to the far mark and back.
steps.shuttle.3: Do that four times. Tap at each turn.
coach.cmj: Hold the phone on your chest. Or tie it with a scarf. Stand still. When I say go, jump up high and land softly.
coach.repeat: Keep the phone on your chest. When I say go, jump again and again until I say stop.
coach.balance: Hold the phone on your chest. Lift one foot. Stand like a tree. Try not to hop.
coach.situp: Lie down. Bend your knees. Put the phone on your chest. Sit up, then lie back. A friend can hold your feet.
coach.react: Hold the phone in your hand. Wait. When the screen turns green, tap it. Do not tap early.
coach.step: Find a low step. Hold the rail. Step up and down. Then put one fingertip on the back camera and hold still.
coach.sprint: Mark a start and a finish. Wait for go. Run straight past the finish. Then tap the button.
coach.shuttle: Two marks, a short run apart. Run there and back, four times. Tap the button at each turn.
coach.result.cmj: Your best jump was about {n} centimetres.
lang.first: Choose a language. You can change it later.
results.conditions: Air and weather saved with this check
results.unreliable: These tries did not match. One more check would be safer.
weather.title: Weather and safety
weather.ask: May we use your area for weather? We save the city and state only. Not the exact spot. You can say no.
weather.heat: It is hot. Drink water, stay in the shade, or test in the evening.
weather.air: The air is poor. Skip the step test and the run if breathing feels hard.
weather.note: City and weather are saved with the result. The exact place is not.
weather.fail: Weather could not be loaded. You can still do the check.
text.help: Large text is easier to read. You can change it any time.
results.next: Next: share this card, look at your progress, or try another test.
progress.radar.sub: Pale shape is the first check. Blue shape is the latest. 100 is the outside.
progress.need: Do {n} more tests to see your trend.
progress.notrace: This saved check has no sensor trace. Do the test again to keep the line.
detail.title: This test
how.title: How this test works
mean.cmj: A higher jump means your legs pushed the ground harder.
tip.cmj: Bend your knees, swing your arms, and land softly.
mean.repeat: More jumps, with a steady height, are better.
tip.repeat: Stay on your toes and keep the phone tight on your chest.
mean.balance: A smaller sway means you stood steadier on one foot.
tip.balance: Look at one spot and stand near a wall.
mean.situp: This counts how many times you sat up.
tip.situp: Keep the phone on your chest and sit up clearly.
mean.react: A smaller number means you tapped sooner after green.
tip.react: Wait for green, then tap. Do not tap early.
mean.step: This is your steps and how your heart changed.
tip.step: Use a low step, hold the rail, then cover the camera softly.
mean.sprint: A shorter time means a faster run.
mean.shuttle: A shorter time means a faster shuttle.
tip.shuttle: Touch the line and turn with short steps.
how.cmj.what: A higher jump means your legs pushed the ground harder.
how.cmj.science: The phone uses the size of the ground pull, not one side of the phone.
how.cmj.sensor: The phone records motion while you do the test. No video is kept.
how.cmj.limit: This is a screening number, not a lab machine and not a team selection.
